widgets_values:
Re-render this photograph as a bold illustrated POSTER, keeping the same composition and every object in place: the window with blinds, the wall of retro horror posters, the wooden desk, the beige CRT television, the keyboard, the cassette stacks, the lava lamp, the plastic toys and the controller.

Illustration style: late-90s anime / cyberpunk poster art. Strong and clearly visible black ink linework with confident varying line weight, hatching and cross-hatching in the shadows, screentone halftone dots as shading, flat cel-shaded colour blocks, deep solid blacks, slight ink misregistration and paper grain like a screen print.

Content: the city picture on the CRT screen has erupted into a dinosaur that is bursting head and shoulders out of the broken glass toward the viewer - jaw wide open in a roar, sharp teeth and tongue, one clawed forelimb planted on the desk, shards of glass and thin speed lines flying around it. Its roar explodes into a giant jagged comic burst balloon containing the words "IDEOGRAM 4.6" in heavy poster lettering: cream letters, very thick black outline, halftone fill, sized big but fully inside the frame.

Lighting and palette: warm orange from the lava lamp on one side, cold cyan glow from the screen on the other, everything else pushed into deep black - high contrast screen-print poster look. No other words anywhere.
